Register an S3 list class with fixed fields as a pytree node

Source: R/tree_util.R
register_dataclass.Rd

Port of jax.tree_util.register_dataclass for S3 classes built on named lists: data_fields become children (with GetAttrKey() paths), meta_fields are static data kept in the treedef. R has no dataclass declarations, so both field lists are required, as JAX requires them for classes that are not dataclasses. Unflattening rebuilds the list with the data and meta fields (in their original order) and the original class attribute.

Usage

register_dataclass(
  nodetype,
  data_fields = NULL,
  meta_fields = NULL,
  drop_fields = character(0)
)

Arguments

nodetype

Class name.

data_fields, meta_fields

Character vectors of field names.

drop_fields

Accepted for compatibility (fields outside data_fields and meta_fields are always dropped).

Value

nodetype, invisibly.
